promote.workspace.launchDemoNote.en: Demo dataset: the launch runs against a fake TikTok inside Studio. Nothing is published and nothing is spent.
promote.workspace.launchDemoNote.zh: 演示数据：投放在 Studio 内置的模拟 TikTok 上运行，不会发布广告，也不会产生广告花费。

promote.workspace.launchSandboxNote.en: TikTok sandbox: objects are created in the sandbox ad account. Nothing is published and nothing is spent.
promote.workspace.launchSandboxNote.zh: TikTok 沙盒：广告对象会在沙盒账户中创建，不会发布，也不会产生广告花费。

promote.workspace.launchLiveNote.en: Pressing launch creates the campaign in your assigned TikTok ad account with the approved budget as its spending ceiling. TikTok reviews the ads before they run.
promote.workspace.launchLiveNote.zh: 点击投放后，会在你的 TikTok 广告账户中以已批准预算为上限创建广告活动。广告需通过 TikTok 审核后才会投放。

promote.workspace.renderedPreview.en: This is the finished ad: the exact file that will be uploaded to TikTok.
promote.workspace.renderedPreview.zh: 这是成品广告，即上传到 TikTok 的文件。

promote.workspace.renderPending.en: Finished video not rendered yet; the source footage is shown.
promote.workspace.renderPending.zh: 成品视频尚未生成，当前显示源片段。

promote.block.budget_unsigned.en: the approver must sign the budget

promote.block.budget_below_minimum.en: the budget must be at least $20 (TikTok's minimum)
promote.block.budget_below_minimum.zh: 预算至少 $20（TikTok 最低要求）

promote.block.no_destination.en: set where viewers should go in the brief
promote.block.no_destination.zh: 在简报中填写观众点击后的去向链接

promote.block.unrendered_creatives.en: every chosen ad needs a finished video; generate the ads again
promote.block.unrendered_creatives.zh: 每条已选广告都需要成品视频，请重新生成广告

promote.block.no_launch_account.en: no TikTok ad account is assigned to your company yet
promote.block.no_launch_account.zh: 你的公司尚未分配 TikTok 广告账户

promote.block.no_identity.en: the assigned ad account has no TikTok handle linked; Pulsar is on it
promote.block.no_identity.zh: 已分配的广告账户尚未关联 TikTok 账号，Pulsar 正在处理

promote.new.destinationHint.en: The link the ad opens: the drama's page on your platform or a web player. TikTok requires it.
promote.new.destinationHint.zh: 广告点击后打开的链接：剧集在你平台上的页面或网页播放器。TikTok 要求必填。

workflow.hint.launch.en: Launch the approved ads with the approved budget. TikTok reviews them before they run.
workflow.hint.launch.zh: 以已批准的预算投放已批准的广告，广告需通过 TikTok 审核后才会开始投放。

workflow.hint.launching.zh: 正在 TikTok 上创建广告活动…

workflow.hint.submitted.en: Created on TikTok. The ads are in TikTok's review; results appear once they run.
workflow.hint.submitted.zh: 已在 TikTok 创建，广告正在 TikTok 审核中，投放后会显示结果。

workflow.hint.waiting.en: Running on TikTok. Results are read back every hour.
workflow.hint.waiting.zh: 正在 TikTok 投放，结果每小时回传一次。

workflow.hint.paused.en: Paused. Nothing is spending until it is switched back on.
workflow.hint.paused.zh: 已暂停，重新开启前不会产生广告花费。

workflow.hint.ended.en: The schedule ended or the budget was spent. Review the results and decide the next round.
workflow.hint.ended.zh: 投放已结束或预算已用完，请查看结果并决定下一轮。

workflow.hint.failed.en: The launch could not complete. Pulsar has been notified and will retry or explain.
workflow.hint.failed.zh: 投放未能完成，Pulsar 已收到通知，将重试或说明原因。

workflow.hint.generating.en: Generating the finished ads. This takes a few minutes; the page refreshes itself.
workflow.hint.generating.zh: 正在生成成品广告，需要几分钟，页面会自动刷新。

workflow.demoMode.en: Demo dataset: launches go to a fake TikTok inside Studio and spend nothing.
workflow.demoMode.zh: 演示数据：投放在 Studio 内置的模拟 TikTok 上运行，不产生广告花费。

ws.exp.mock.en: Demo dataset: the launch runs against a fake TikTok inside Studio and spends nothing.
ws.exp.mock.zh: 演示数据：投放在 Studio 内置的模拟 TikTok 上运行，不产生广告花费。

ws.exp.noResults.en: No results yet. Studio reads them back from TikTok every hour once the ads run.
ws.exp.noResults.zh: 还没有结果。广告开始投放后，Studio 每小时从 TikTok 回传一次。

ws.exp.signal.views.zh: 视频观看与 2 秒留存

ws.exp.benchmark.en: Benchmarks: hook hold {hold}%, CTR {ctr}%. Above both = worth more spend.
ws.exp.benchmark.zh: 基准：2 秒留存 {hold}%，点击率 {ctr}%。两项都高于基准 = 值得追加投入。

ws.launchAccount.sub.en: The ad account your campaigns launch into. Pulsar sets it up inside Pulsar's Business Center and assigns it to your company.
ws.launchAccount.sub.zh: 你的广告活动投放所用的广告账户。Pulsar 在自己的商务中心中创建并分配给你的公司。

ws.launchAccount.noIdentity.en: No TikTok handle linked yet — Pulsar is completing the setup.
ws.launchAccount.noIdentity.zh: 尚未关联 TikTok 账号，Pulsar 正在完成设置。

ws.launchAccount.request.en: Request an ad account from Pulsar
ws.launchAccount.request.zh: 向 Pulsar 申请广告账户

ws.launchAccount.requestSub.en: Pulsar creates the account and links a publishing handle. You will be able to launch as soon as it is assigned.
ws.launchAccount.requestSub.zh: Pulsar 会创建账户并关联发布账号，分配完成后即可投放。

ws.launchAccount.note.zh: 需要告知 Pulsar 的信息

ws.launchAccount.paymentSub.en: Optional. Ad spend on a Pulsar-managed account is billed back to you. Studio records the card brand, holder and last four digits only — never the card number — and charges nothing itself.
ws.launchAccount.paymentSub.zh: 选填。Pulsar 托管账户上的广告花费会向你结算。Studio 只记录卡品牌、持卡人和末四位，不记录卡号，也不会自行扣款。

ws.launchAccount.sent.en: Request sent. Pulsar will assign the account.
ws.launchAccount.sent.zh: 申请已提交，Pulsar 将分配账户。

ws.launchAccount.viewerOnly.en: An editor or approver can request an account.
ws.launchAccount.viewerOnly.zh: 编辑或审批人可以申请账户。

ws.billing.state.en: Ad spend is billed to the payment method on the launch account. Studio charges nothing itself.
ws.billing.state.zh: 广告花费通过投放账户上的支付方式结算，Studio 不会自行扣款。

admin.promote.next.failed.zh: 投放失败，需重试或说明

admin.promote.next.done.zh: 投放中 · 每小时回传数据

admin.promote.launch.submitted.en: Created on TikTok with {n} ads; TikTok is reviewing them. Nothing to do unless the review stalls.
admin.promote.launch.submitted.zh: 已在 TikTok 创建 {n} 条广告，TikTok 审核中。除非审核停滞，无需操作。

admin.promote.launch.launching.en: The launch engine is creating the objects on TikTok. If this stays here for more than ten minutes, the scheduler adopts it; Sync now forces it.
admin.promote.launch.launching.zh: 投放引擎正在 TikTok 上创建对象。若超过十分钟未变化，调度器会接管；也可点击“立即同步”。

admin.promote.launch.live.en: Delivering on TikTok. Metrics are read back hourly.
admin.promote.launch.live.zh: 正在 TikTok 投放，数据每小时回传。

admin.promote.launch.paused.en: Paused on TikTok. Nothing spends until it is resumed.
admin.promote.launch.paused.zh: 已在 TikTok 暂停，恢复前不产生花费。

admin.promote.launch.ended.en: Ended: schedule closed or budget spent.
admin.promote.launch.ended.zh: 已结束：排期结束或预算用完。

admin.promote.launch.failed.en: The launch failed. Fix the cause (the note says what TikTok answered) and retry — the same launch record resumes; no second campaign is created.
admin.promote.launch.failed.zh: 投放失败。根据备注中 TikTok 的回复修正后重试，会沿用同一投放记录，不会创建第二个活动。

admin.promote.launch.synced.en: Synced: {polled} campaigns polled, {synced} result rows, {errors} errors.
admin.promote.launch.synced.zh: 已同步：轮询 {polled} 个活动，{synced} 条结果，{errors} 个错误。

admin.promote.launch.overrideNote.en: The engine and the scheduler write the normal path. Use this only when TikTok's state and Studio's disagree and you have checked Ads Manager.
admin.promote.launch.overrideNote.zh: 正常情况下由引擎和调度器写入状态。仅当 TikTok 与 Studio 状态不一致且已在 Ads Manager 核实时使用。

admin.promote.launch.notApplied.en: TikTok accepted the request but did not change state; the next sweep settles it.
admin.promote.launch.notApplied.zh: TikTok 已接受请求但状态未变，下一次轮询会处理。

admin.tiktok.sub.en: The operator connection to Pulsar's Business Center, the ad accounts it reaches, and which producer each launches from.
admin.tiktok.sub.zh: Pulsar 商务中心的运营方连接、可用的广告账户，以及各制片方使用的投放账户。

admin.tiktok.mode.fake.en: Fixture: fake TikTok in this process
admin.tiktok.mode.fake.zh: 演示：本进程内的模拟 TikTok

admin.tiktok.connected.en: TikTok authorized. The new connection is listed below.
admin.tiktok.connected.zh: TikTok 授权成功，新连接已列出。

admin.tiktok.redirectUri.en: Redirect URI to register on the developer app
admin.tiktok.redirectUri.zh: 需在开发者应用中注册的回调地址

admin.tiktok.assignTitle.en: Assign ad account {id} to a producer
admin.tiktok.assignTitle.zh: 将广告账户 {id} 分配给制片方

admin.tiktok.accountName.en: Account name shown to the producer
admin.tiktok.accountName.zh: 向制片方显示的账户名称

admin.tiktok.identityNone.en: No handle linked to this ad account — link one in Business Center before assigning, or ads cannot run.
admin.tiktok.identityNone.zh: 该广告账户未关联 TikTok 账号，请先在商务中心关联，否则广告无法投放。

admin.tiktok.scheduler.stopped.en: Not running in this process (SCHEDULER_DISABLED or no boot hook). Sync now still works.
admin.tiktok.scheduler.stopped.zh: 本进程未运行调度器（SCHEDULER_DISABLED 或无启动钩子），仍可点击“立即同步”。

admin.promote.sub.en: Every producer ad campaign: what it needs from Pulsar, and how its TikTok launch is doing.
admin.promote.sub.zh: 每个制片方的广告活动：需要 Pulsar 处理的事项，以及 TikTok 投放进展。
